svg.title: Databricks developer layer stack
svg.desc: Bottom-up view of how a developer interacts with each layer: S3, Delta, IAM, Spark, and Jobs

g.text: You never read S3 directly. You point Delta at it and it manages the rest.
Wraps S3 with ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and time travel
Who can read/write which table or S3 path — enforced before Spark touches data
The runtime that executes your code against Delta tables — SQL, Python, or Scala
How you run code on a schedule or trigger — wraps a notebook, script, or jar
